Option A — utility light: calm cards, teal + copper, Archivo/IBM Plex. Driver flow, left to right: scan the charger QR, confirm the rate and the ₱1,500 hold, authorize via Maya, watch the live session, get the receipt. S6 is the optional account view.
Amounts match the blueprint doc: ₱48.50/kWh, 18.4 kWh → ₱892.40 captured, ₱607.60 released.
